mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_document (document_num, group_num, member_num, document_title, original_name, stored_name, document_path, document_type, document_size, hit, created_at) VALUES (gdocument_seq.nextVal, #{group_num}, #{member_num}, #{document_title}, #{original_name}, #{stored_name}, #{document_path}, #{document_type}, #{document_size}, #{hit}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT d.document_num, d.document_title, m.member_nick, d.original_name, d.stored_name, d.document_path, d.document_type, d.document_size, d.hit, d.created_at, d.updated_at, FN_GROUP_RESOURCE_PERMISSION(d.group_num, d.member_num, #{member_num}) AS can_manage FROM group_document d JOIN member m ON d.member_num = m.member_num WHERE d.group_num = #{group_num} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
SELECT document_title, original_name FROM group_document WHERE document_num = #{document_num}
